description: This file provides filesystem utility functions for disk and inode usage, including system calls to retrieve filesystem statistics and quota information, specifically for Linux and Darwin systems within the Kubernetes project.

classes.name: UsageInfo
classes.description: Struct to hold disk usage and inode count information.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Retrieves filesystem statistics such as available bytes, total capacity, usage, total inodes, free inodes, and used inodes for a given path.

methods.name: DiskUsage
methods.description: Calculates disk usage and inode count for a specified directory, utilizing quota system if available, otherwise walking the directory tree.
